label: Audit Issue Rating Calibrator
description: Ensures consistent severity rating of audit findings across the engagement and function. Applies a structured rating framework (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Informational) with evidence-based justification.

guidedInputs.label: Findings to calibrate
guidedInputs.description: Paste the finding descriptions (or summaries) along with the proposed ratings. If multiple findings, number them.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Finding 1 (proposed High): 3 of 50 sampled customer files had no EDD despite PEP status. Finding 2 (proposed Critical): TM alert queue exceeded 90 days for 220 of 850 open alerts. Finding 3 (proposed Medium): training completion rate for KYC staff was 74% vs. 90% target...

options.label: Regulatory: Matters Requiring Immediate Attention / Matters Requiring Attention / Observations

guidedInputs.label: Institution type / regulatory context
guidedInputs.description: Affects the regulatory risk weighting applied to findings.

guidedInputs.label: Calibration concerns or context (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Two team members have rated similar findings differently. Management is pushing back on the Critical rating for Finding 2. We are uncertain whether the training finding rises to High given the small gap.
